anchor: UTC day D containing confirmedAsOf() close
source: Binance Spot /api/v3/klines interval=1d, UTC default; explicit start/end
sourceDays: exact D-20 through D-1 inclusive, consecutive UTC days including weekends
today: max high - min low over continuous closed S.k prefix in D from UTC open to confirmed anchor
ratioPercent: 100*today/ADR, valid coverage and finite positive ADR only
midnight: new D has zero confirmed candles: wait, never reuse old day
cacheKeySemantics: source open +1d for pivot validity; ADR uses explicit source open
missingPolicy: no forward fill or shortened period; historical negative cache refreshed explicitly, existing failed/latest source retry15s
